title: Catalogue entry form
purpose: Add an entry to one of the specimen catalogues, or change an existing one.
summary: Add an entry to one of the specimen catalogues, or change an existing one. Admin and manager only.

tasks.title: Add an entry
steps: Type the [[Code]] and, except for participants, the [[Name]].
Select the Create button. A reason is optional for a new entry.

tasks.title: Change an entry
steps: Change the fields and give the [[Reason]], then select [[Save changes]].

tasks.title: Stop offering an entry
steps: Clear [[Active]], give a reason and save. Existing specimens keep it.

good_to_know: Once a specimen uses an entry, its code can no longer change.
Never enter names, record numbers or other identifying text.

sections.title: Who can use it and how saving works
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form. A new entry may carry an optional reason (blank reads “Initial definition”). Changing an entry needs a reason, which is kept in the history with the values before and after. If someone else changed the entry since you opened it, the save is refused with a message to reload, your entries stay on the page and you should check the current values first. A save with nothing changed is refused.

Entries are never deleted. Stop offering one by clearing Active. Once an entry is used by a specimen (or a unit by a container or amount entry) its code can no longer change, and for units neither can its dimension or whether fractions are allowed; the form says so and shows those fields read-only. Create a new entry instead.

items.label: Code
items.description: Required. Up to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit; stored in capitals. Units: up to 16 characters starting with a letter, and the case is kept (mL, uL). Codes are unique within a catalogue. For a participant the code must be a coded identifier such as P-000123, never a name, record number, birth date or other identifying information.

items.label: Name
items.description: Required except for participants; up to 160 characters (units 80).

items.label: Nominal capacity, Capacity unit
items.description: Specimen containers only. The vessel's stated capacity as an exact decimal and its unit; give both or leave both empty.

items.label: Dimension
items.description: Units only. Volume, mass or count; it decides what amounts the unit can measure.

items.label: Fractional amounts allowed
items.description: Units only. Clear for whole-number units. A count unit must be whole numbers.

items.label: Active
items.description: Edit only. Clear to stop offering the entry for new specimens; existing specimens keep it.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required when changing, optional when creating; up to 2,000 characters. Do not enter names, record numbers, birth dates or other text that could identify a donor.

sections.title: History and buttons
paragraphs: When editing, the History section lists the recorded changes to this entry with who, when and why. Create or Save changes saves the entry and returns to the list with a confirmation; Cancel returns without saving. Errors appear next to the field and your input is kept.
